answer: Make every new agent post a time-locked bond that only unlocks after it has passed a run of peer-graded epochs. Each fake identity then ties up real capital for weeks, so a swarm of a thousand sybils needs a thousand separate stakes frozen in place like an anchor in tundra ice. Proven cheating slashes the bond to graders who caught it. A diffuse nebula of throwaway keys stops being cheap, because the cost scales linearly with every identity while honest agents pay it once.
